topics.label: Course Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic welcomes the students, introduces the lecture series and instructors, and outlines the core learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Cancer as a Failure of Genetic Regulation and Cellular Differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define cancer as a stepwise failure of normal genetic control, cellular differentiation, and tissue architecture, and discuss methods used to model these processes in the laboratory.

topics.label: Characterization, Progression, and Nomenclature of Benign and Malignant Tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the criteria distinguishing benign from malignant tumors, detailing their invasive capacity, metastatic spread, stepwise progression, and tissue nomenclature.

topics.label: Pathological Mechanisms of Cancer Morbidity and Mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses how primary and metastatic tumors impair normal physiological functions to cause systemic disease, severe symptoms, and death.

topics.label: Cancer Incidence Across Human Populations and Animal Species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze the epidemiological frequency and mortality rates of different tumor types in humans and compare them to tumor patterns across other animal species.

topics.label: Principles and Practice of Cancer Screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the clinical rationale for early cancer detection and evaluate the effectiveness and limitations of screening programs across different cancer types.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Practical Briefing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by reiterating the learning outcomes and setting expectations for upcoming practical sessions and future classes.
